First public release.
Complete adventure: eight medals, the League and the Hall of Legacy.

description:
**Elementis Zeta** is a creature-collecting RPG for the Flipper Zero. Explore towns, routes, caves and gyms, catch and train original creatures, win eight medals and take on the League.

# Features

- Turn-based battles against trainers and wild creatures, with items, status effects, evolutions and a creature box on the PC.
- Original creatures, map, characters and music, all made for this game.
- Four-level grayscale on the Flipper's 1-bit screen, using a fast temporal flicker.
- Four languages: Spanish, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. You pick one on the first launch and can change it any time in Options.
- Registry of the creatures you have seen and caught, trainer card, save and continue, Hall of Legacy and credits.
- Music and sound effects on the speaker, with a switch to turn them off.
- Experimental: trade creatures and fight exhibition battles with a friend over the infrared port, two Flippers face to face.

# Controls

- D-pad: move and navigate menus.
- OK: talk, interact and confirm.
- Back (short press): open the pause menu or cancel.
- Back (hold): quit the game.

# Requirements

- A Flipper Zero with a healthy microSD card (an A1 card of 16 to 32 GB is recommended). The game keeps its assets and saves there.
- The first launch unpacks about 5 MB of assets to the SD card and takes a while (over a minute). Do not power off during that time.
- The game uses most of the Flipper's RAM: close other apps before playing.
- Saves are in apps_data/elementis_zeta on the SD card. The game is saved only when you choose Save in the pause menu.
- Built for the official firmware 1.5.1 (API 88).

# About

Elementis Zeta is an original game. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any other game or company, and it uses no names, characters, creatures or art from them.

Design, programming and art: Daniel Jahziel. The art was made with PixelLab, an AI pixel-art tool. Japanese and Chinese text uses Fusion Pixel Font by TakWolf (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and its component fonts; the licence texts ship with the app.

Code under GPL-3.0. Art and game content: all rights reserved (the app may be built and shared unmodified). Source code and bug reports: https://github.com/jahziel1/Elementis-Zeta
